name: Korean peninsula
summary: North Korea tested a cluster-warhead ballistic missile on 31 Oct
state: North Korea fired a tactical ballistic missile towards the Yellow Sea on 31 Oct, testing a cluster warhead, two days after a salvo of about ten short-range missiles on 29 Oct. The FBI said on 1 Nov that North Korea was behind the $6.3bn Binance theft. No further launch had been reported as of 2 Nov.
for_you: No direct risk to the UK. Travellers to South Korea can follow FCDO travel advice.
